coverage_simulation.dgp: Independent period samples; stationary binary-X-dependent cohort composition; conditional parallel trends; group-X levels; time-X trends; heterogeneous normal variance; constant declared group-time treatment effects.
coverage_simulation.nuisance_contract: Two-fold cross-fitted saturated binary-X propensity and four group-period outcome means per fixed comparison; no oracle predictions, clipping, or trimming.
coverage_simulation.finite_sample_support_contract: Every period-X-cohort cell has population expected count of at least 32; any realized fold-support failure is recorded as a refusal, never repaired.
